Timetable sources

The nine 2026–27 PDFs drive the weekly schedule. The first-year PDF has four pages dated 2024–25 and is archived, not combined with current schedules.

How matching works

A room matches only if no listed class overlaps any part of your requested stay. A class starting exactly when you leave does not overlap.

Text search uses a small, locally trained statistical intent classifier for floor and cooling language, plus explicit time and number parsing. The same lightweight parser runs through the Roomwise server API for the main search flow, needs no API key, and is not a general-purpose AI chatbot. Review the interpreted filters before choosing a room.

Schedules recur Monday–Friday from the supplied 2026–27 timetable. Semester dates, holidays, weekend schedules, opening hours, other departments, and real-time occupancy are not supplied. Searches are limited to the timetable window of 09:00–16:50. Lunch and short breaks have no listed classes; they do not guarantee access.

Morning and afternoon sections are combined for shared rooms. For entries listing two labs, both venues are blocked conservatively. Labs are visible but never recommended as open classrooms. Number-only room references are associated with IST, except explicit TB 106, and should be confirmed locally.

Floor numbers are never inferred from room numbers. Morning-only, afternoon-only, and shared specialist rooms have incomplete coverage. A free result means no class in the supplied records, not proof that a room is physically empty.
